jobId.description: Tracking identifier for the async deploy job; passed to `deploy status` to poll progress.

status.description: Initial job state from the synchronous deploy response — always 'CREATED' per contract (§5.6).

DeployResult.description: Shape returned by `sf data-cloud deploy` (and what `--json` emits).

DeploymentLifecycleStatus.description: Deploy job lifecycle states (§5.6): the synchronous response is always CREATED; the job then advances to INPROGRESS and finally SUCCESS or FAILED, polled via `sf data-cloud deploy status`.
